WITH case_counts AS (
    SELECT
        case_id
    FROM event_log
    GROUP BY case_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 6
)
SELECT el.*
FROM event_log el
JOIN case_counts cc
  ON el.case_id = cc.case_id;
```

```sql
ORDER BY el.case_id, el.timestamp;
```
